nesnd_feedback_patron_crown_tt: 削弱地方士人与军府，扩大皇权的比重。只能扶持一派；皇权低于#v 40%#!时自动结束，也可主动撤销。
Weaken the provincial literati and military in favour of the Crown. Only one faction may receive patronage. It ends if the Crown falls below #v 40%#! or we withdraw it.
nesnd_feedback_patron_literati_tt: 削弱皇权与军府，扩大地方士人的比重。只能扶持一派；地方士人势力低于#v 40%#!时自动结束，也可主动撤销。
Weaken the Crown and military in favour of the provincial literati. Only one faction may receive patronage. It ends if the literati fall below #v 40%#! or we withdraw it.
nesnd_feedback_patron_army_tt: 削弱皇权与地方士人，扩大军府的比重。只能扶持一派；军府势力低于#v 40%#!时自动结束，也可主动撤销。
Weaken the Crown and provincial literati in favour of the military. Only one faction may receive patronage. It ends if the military falls below #v 40%#! or we withdraw it.
nesnd_feedback_patron_cancel_tt: 撤销当前扶持及其修正，恢复另两方被压低的势力。
Withdraw the current patronage and its modifiers, restoring the weight it had taken from the other two factions.
nesnd_feedback_coup_tt: 撤销当前派系扶持；#v 五年#!内不能再次发动此类政变。
End the current faction patronage. Another such change of government cannot be attempted for #v five years#!.
nesnd_feedback_law_push_tt: #v 六个月#!后可再次责令议法。
This proposal can be pressed again after #v six months#!.
nesnd_feedback_economy_push_tt: 势力平衡点向安国派移动#v 25#!点。#v 六个月#!后可再次提出。
Move the balance of power #v 25#! points towards the Economic Faction. This proposal can be made again after #v six months#!.
nesnd_feedback_army_petition_tt: 势力平衡点向统治派移动#v 10#!点。#v 十二个月#!后可再次呈报边功。
Move the balance of power #v 10#! points towards the Military Faction. Frontier victories may be presented again after #v twelve months#!.
nesnd_feedback_economy_petition_tt: 势力平衡点向安国派移动#v 10#!点。#v 十二个月#!后可再次呈报新政。
Move the balance of power #v 10#! points towards the Economic Faction. Reform achievements may be presented again after #v twelve months#!.
nesnd_feedback_military_budget_tt: 势力平衡点向统治派移动#v 10#!点。#v 六个月#!后可再次拨款。
Move the balance of power #v 10#! points towards the Military Faction. Further funding may be provided after #v six months#!.
nesnd_feedback_per_aid_tt: 选定求援路线，“近西帝国的前途”每月进度#p +2#!。选择后不能更改。
Commit to seeking Qin aid. Progress towards the Near-Western Empire’s future increases by #p 2#! each month. This choice is final.
nesnd_feedback_per_covert_tt: 选定联络诸部的路线，“近西帝国的前途”每月进度#p +2#!。部署期间，西秦的文化团结度每月#n −1#!。选择后不能更改。

nesnd_feedback_per_maintenance_tt: 持续满足上述条件时，每月维持这项修正。
